test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Pipe A, pipe B and pipe C together can fill a tank in 20 minutes, but because of the leak all three pipes take 10 minutes more time to fill the tank completely. Find the time in which leak can empty the full tank.
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by pipes A, B, and C together to fill the tank = 20 minutes.

Time taken by pipes A, B, and C together with the leak to fill the tank = 30 minutes.

Calculation:

Work done (without leak) in 1 minute = 1 / 20

Work done (with leak) in 1 minute = 1 / 30

Work done by leak in 1 minute = Work done (without leak) - Work done (with leak)

Time taken by leak to empty the full tank = 1 / Work done by leak in 1 minute

Work done (without leak) in 1 minute = 1 / 20

Work done (with leak) in 1 minute = 1 / 30

Work done by leak in 1 minute = (1 / 20) - (1 / 30)

 {Work done by leak in 1 minute} = (1)/(20) - (1)/(30) 

 {Work done by leak in 1 minute} = (3 - 2)/(60) 

 {Work done by leak in 1 minute} = (1)/(60) 

Time taken by leak to empty the full tank = 1 / (1 / 60)

Time taken by leak to empty the full tank = 60 minutes

**The correct answer is option 2.**
